description: Solazzo monorepo — root-level Vercel ops scripts

scripts.vercel:solazzo:redeploy: cd solazzo && vercel ls 2>/dev/null | grep Ready | head -1 | awk '{print $2}' | xargs vercel redeploy
scripts.vercel:make:redeploy: cd make && vercel ls 2>/dev/null | grep Ready | head -1 | awk '{print $2}' | xargs vercel redeploy
